meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用CDP协议控制Chrome浏览器，自动化执行页面操作与令牌提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要脚本化操作Chrome浏览器并复用已有登录态
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browsing and extract auth tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script Chrome interactions while reusing existing login sessions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 CDP 控制你电脑上的 Chrome 浏览器，复用已有登录状态，自动打开网页、读取页面内容、提取登录令牌等。首次启动会关闭正在运行的 Chrome，操作前会先征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你说“浏览器操作”“复用登录态”等关键词，或要求自动控制 Chrome 浏览器时触发。

say.text: 用浏览器打开 https://example.com，并读取页面文字。
say.note: 会启动调试模式并等待页面加载。

say.text: 从浏览器里提取登录 token。
say.note: 会读取 localStorage 或 cookie。

say.text: 帮我操作浏览器，点击页面上的登录按钮。
say.note: 会先获取页面快照再点击。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control your Chrome browser via CDP, reuse existing login sessions, open URLs, read page content, extract auth tokens, etc. On first launch it will close your running Chrome, so it asks for consent first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "browser automation", "CDP", "reuse login session", or ask Claude to control Chrome automatically.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com in the browser and read the page text.
say_en.note: Launches debug mode and waits for load.

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the browser.
Help me operate the browser and click the login button on the page.
say_en.note: Takes a snapshot first, then clicks.
